name: LyricLine — API on RapidAPI
description:
Full lyrics with the track context attached: LyricLine returns complete song lyrics together with track and artist details in one response, and a suggestion endpoint that helps users find the right song before they query.

What you get:
- Full song lyrics for a track, returned as display-ready text
- Track details (title, artist, album context) in the same response — no second lookup to label what you display
- Artist information for building artist pages and related-content links
- A suggest endpoint that resolves partial or misspelled titles into candidate tracks, so a "not found" becomes a choice instead of a dead end

Key endpoints:
- GET /lyrics — full lyrics for a song
- GET /track — track details
- GET /artist — artist information
- GET /suggest — candidate tracks for a partial or uncertain query

Batch / built for workflows:
LyricLine is designed for music content flows: search-suggest first, then one call per song returns lyrics plus the metadata set needed to render a complete page. Responses are edge-cached, so repeat lookups of popular tracks stay fast, and the suggest fallback keeps catalogue-import and playlist-enrichment jobs moving when a title does not match exactly.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
